title: Highdel's Vanilla Revamp
description: A vanilla-style resourcepack that sublty tweaks and refines exisiting textures to make the game feel more polished while staying true to the original look.
body: This resource pack subtly enhances the vanilla Minecraft experience by refining textures with a deeper understanding of color theory. Maintaining the original vanilla color palette, it brings a more vibrant and consistent look. Every texture is handcrafted pixel by pixel, without the use of automated tools, ensuring a unique and authentic touch. Ideal for players who love the classic Minecraft aesthetic but want a more polished and visually appealing environment.
